risks.note: Management names availability of quality cotton as an identifiable risk and concern for the textile industry that may have a severe impact on the Company's operating and financial performance; the spinning business is cotton-based.

Listed both as a risk and concern in the MD&A and as a threat; management is relying on further supportive government measures to soften the price of cotton and other raw materials, i.e. the mitigation is outside the Company's control.
risks.risk: Erratic cotton price movement and raw material cost fluctuation

risks.note: Flagged as an identifiable risk for the industry; the Company mitigates part of it by consuming the entire output of its 13.195 MW wind mills captively at the spinning unit, but the balance of power and input cost remains exposed.
risks.risk: High cost of power and other inputs

risks.note: Named by management among the identifiable risks and concerns for the textile industry, relevant to a spinning, processing and garmenting operation.
Listed as a threat in the MD&A; the Company is historically a cotton yarn spinner predominantly in the hosiery segment, so a demand shift away from cotton is a structural mix risk.
risks.risk: Structural shift to Man Made Fibre

risks.note: Management states the US-Iran war has severely affected the business environment in India, bringing spiralling oil prices, supply-chain issues and a glut-like situation.

The MD&A frames the industry's long term sustainable future as subject to the extension of supportive measures by the appropriate governments and availability of a favourable business climate, and the optimistic outlook rests on Government initiatives such as the Union Budget 2026-27 textile programme and Mega Textile Parks.

Stated near-term visibility rests on large Ministry of Defence / Department of Military Affairs orders for Extreme Cold Weather Clothing System suits (15,000 sets to be supplied before June 2026 and 24,585 sets during FY2026-27), making order flow from a single government customer a structural dependency.
